metadata.description: Distill the essence of any content into an image prompt — the 8 transformation principles (understand / select / translate / consistent / compose / style / negative / faithful) compress a whole text into still imagery (one image or several, depending on the format).

plugins.name: distill-essence-engine
plugins.description: Distill Essence Engine — turns any content (novel, article, poem, transcript, memo, paper …) into an English image prompt via the transformation principles (understand → select → translate → consistent → compose → style → negative → faithful). Core quality = particular × indirect (show the truth, entrusted).
